newsitem.title: USA: Sterling to acquire First Houston.
newsitem.headline: Sterling to acquire First Houston.

text.p: Sterling Bancshares Inc said Tuesday it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire First Houston Bancshares Inc and its Houston National Bank unit in a stock for stock deal.

Sterling said the agreement provides that holders of First Houston will receive 0.707 shares of Sterling common stock for each First Houston share, subject to possible adjustments prior to closing, Sterling said.
Based upon First Houston's financial statements at December 31, 1996, the deal will add to Sterling's franchise $132 million in assets and $123 million in deposits, Sterling said.
